features.description: Create bounded artifact sessions for one Build-to-Learn artifact.
expectedBehavior: Runtime creates, stores, reloads, and enforces an artifact boundary.
verificationSteps: Run npm test.
Run create_artifact_session STDIO smoke with allowed and rejected paths.

features.description: Build a small evidence-cited concept graph from an artifact session.
expectedBehavior: Runtime returns human-readable concept nodes and flow edges with citations.
verificationSteps: Run npm test.
Validate a fixture graph has at least five nodes and one flow edge.

features.description: Prepare one autopsy step where the user attempts before explanation.
expectedBehavior: Runtime returns bounded evidence and an attempt-first prompt for a selected concept or flow.
verificationSteps: Run npm test.
Inspect autopsy step output for prompt, evidence, and no answer-first explanation.

features.description: Harden ownership question policy for evidence-backed, bounded questions.
preconditions: F03 autopsy step exists or existing question runtime is available.
expectedBehavior: Runtime produces one to three questions with target area, why it matters, style, and evidence.
verificationSteps: Run npm test.
Assert question count and evidence fields across fixture cases.

features.description: Detect learning gaps and misconceptions from answers and artifact evidence.
preconditions: F03 autopsy step and F04 question policy exist.
expectedBehavior: Runtime emits LearningGap or confirmed concept state with evidence and confidence.
verificationSteps: Run npm test.
Run fixtures for partial, wrong, and uncertainty answers.

features.description: Generate repair practice challenges tied to detected gaps.
expectedBehavior: Runtime creates PracticeChallenge entries with expected evidence and revisit timing.
verificationSteps: Run npm test.
Assert every challenge references a gap id and expected evidence.

features.description: Persist inspectable understanding memory across resumed sessions.
preconditions: F05 gaps and F06 challenges exist.
expectedBehavior: Runtime stores concept states, answer history, gaps, challenges, and review timing per artifact.
verificationSteps: Run npm test.
Reload state from isolated SIBI_RUNTIME_HOME and inspect memory.

features.description: Export evidence-backed readiness reports as JSON and Markdown.
expectedBehavior: Runtime emits ready/risky areas, open gaps, practice queue, next action, and evidence index.
verificationSteps: Run npm test.
Assert every readiness claim cites evidence.

features.description: Create canonical eval dataset contracts for Sibi pedagogy and boundaries.
expectedBehavior: Eval dataset covers all required case classes with expected outputs.
Worker researches and justifies pilot and scale dataset sizes before benchmark-quality claims.
verificationSteps: Validate dataset index.
Confirm each case declares expected layer, evidence, and readiness fields.
Inspect dataset_sizing_research.md for methodology, strata, pilot size, scale size, and cost/runtime tradeoff.

features.description: Run deterministic pedagogy evals without an LLM.
expectedBehavior: Eval runner verifies deterministic pedagogy behavior and reports per-case mismatches.
verificationSteps: Run npm test or eval command.
Inspect eval report for aggregate counts and mismatches.

features.description: Add bounded Codex Project Learning Agent with model candidate signals and deterministic validation.
expectedBehavior: Runtime captures Codex candidate signals, validates boundaries/evidence/layers, and stores traces with model name and reasoning effort.
verificationSteps: Run npm test.
Run fixture model response trace eval.
Confirm uncited and out-of-bound signals are rejected.
Confirm traces can represent Codex gpt-5.2 medium output.

features.description: Run LLM+runtime trace evals for model-assisted pedagogy behavior.
expectedBehavior: Eval suite records PedagogyTrace artifacts and accepted/rejected signal decisions.
Eval report compares Codex gpt-5.2 medium against Codex gpt-5.5 low on identical cases.
verificationSteps: Run trace evals with fixture responses.
Optionally run live Codex eval when configured.
Compare gpt-5.2 medium and gpt-5.5 low outputs using the same dataset, prompt/schema, artifact boundary, and deterministic validator.

features.description: Render the Build-to-Learn session in a reusable Swift study panel.
expectedBehavior: Swift panel renders runtime snapshot without owning pedagogy or memory state.
verificationSteps: Run swift test.
Render fixture snapshot or record manual panel evidence.

features.description: Host the runtime-owned study panel in a standalone SwiftUI app.
expectedBehavior: Swift app refreshes and renders runtime-owned study snapshots without owning pedagogy or memory state.
verificationSteps: Run swift build.
Run swift test.
Run npm test.
Run npm run typecheck.

features.description: Replace the study app window with an NSPanel surface and Graph + Code canvas.
expectedBehavior: Swift app launches as an accessory floating panel, can collapse, and opens a runtime-owned Graph + Code canvas.
verificationSteps: Run swift build.
Run swift test.
Run npm test.
Run npm run typecheck.
